description:
Source issue: https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/834
Parent contract: zaq-zqq (read before implementation).

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
lib/zaq/agent/input_prompt.ex and factory.ex; matching input_prompt_test.exs and factory tests. InputPrompt.render_message/2 renders normalized author/time/content with the agreed text header and existing attachment handling. Quote/escape only the author name onto one line; preserve body text. Choose Sent at or Recorded at from provenance, omit absent timestamp and absent Person identifier. Use DateUtils.format_ts/1; never call utc_now to invent message time. Preserve native system/tool roles and tool-call pairing; do not wrap tool payloads merely to repeat identity.
Factory.runtime_system_prompt/2 composes one explanatory instruction with configured job and skill index. Existing build_runtime_config and ensure_system_prompt/2 -> Jido.AI.set_system_prompt/3 handle initial/warm prompt configuration. No new transport/update mechanism or configured-agent special case.
Tests to add before implementation: exact headers, empty/attachment-only bodies, quotes/newlines/control-like strings/Unicode in names, no time, source/recorded time, name/body separation property tests, preserved attachment handles, Factory job/skills/system override composition and no duplicated instruction. Verify native tool-call structure remains intact.
Branches/paths validated: known/unknown human, assistant name/fallback, supplied raw message containing header-like text. Avoid duplicate rendering by call-path ownership, not heuristic parsing of user content. Token budgeting receives formatted text naturally; no RequestTransformer rendering changes.
Mocking plan: pure renderer tests and real Factory/Jido integration; only provider transport mocked.
Documentations to update: InputPrompt/Factory moduledocs and docs/services/agent.md explaining header semantics, timestamp provenance and user-controlled text not being authority.
Action reuse assessment: extend existing InputPrompt presentation and Factory lifecycle. Local-only formatter with no database, permissions or side effects; reuse Jido system-prompt API. No new Action/tool.
Acceptance: one formatter and one existing prompt configuration flow cover all configured agents.
title: [#834] Add compact message renderer and Factory prompt integration
